character_profiles.name: Bolt
character_profiles.build: Compact, slightly blocky, retro-futuristic robot with visible joints
character_profiles.face_details: Simple round head with large, expressive, blinking blue optical sensors that display emotion
character_profiles.outfit: Chassis of matte-grey metal plating with slight wear and subtle rust on the joints
character_profiles.distinguishing_features: Blinking blue LED eyes that change shape to show worry, and slightly creaky, exposed mechanical joints
character_profiles.reference_prompt: A Pixar-style 3D animated character portrait of Bolt, a shy matte-grey robot. Bolt has a compact, slightly blocky retro-futuristic build with visible, slightly worn joints. Its round head features large, glowing blue optical sensors that look expressive and slightly anxious. The lighting is warm and realistic, highlighting the soft, non-reflective matte metallic texture of its body in a semi-stylized aesthetic.
